answer: One concrete mechanism: require consistent long-form persona presence across two disconnected communities. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The timber of work and the lantern of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a haven to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
